Interface IPosition

All Known Implementing Classes:
Position
public interface IPosition
Represents a position on the Battleship board, identified by its row and column. Tracks whether the position is occupied by a ship and whether it has been shot at.

    • equals

      boolean equals(Object other)
      Compares this position with another object by row and column. Occupation and shot status do not affect equality.
      Overrides:
      equals in class Object
      Parameters:
      other - the object to compare with this position
      Returns:
      true if the object is an IPosition with the same row and column; false otherwise, including for null

    • isAdjacentTo

      boolean isAdjacentTo(IPosition other)
      Checks whether another position is within one row and one column of this position. This includes horizontal, vertical and diagonal neighbours, as well as positions with identical coordinates.
      Parameters:
      other - the non-null position to check
      Returns:
      true if both coordinate differences are at most one; false otherwise
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if other is null

    • occupy

      void occupy()
      Marks this position as occupied by a ship. Has no additional effect if the position is already occupied.

    • shoot

      void shoot()
      Marks this position as having been shot at, whether or not it is occupied. Has no additional effect if the position has already been shot at.

    • isOccupied

      boolean isOccupied()
      Checks whether this position is occupied by a ship.
      Returns:
      true if occupied; false otherwise

    • isHit

      boolean isHit()
      Checks whether this position has been shot at. A true result does not necessarily mean that a ship was hit.
      Returns:
      true if this position has been shot at; false otherwise
